entries.reason: a fence of the port is the signal value of a shared event, and the value it is brought to is how many commands this encoder has encoded, which is how far the work has been brought: a command here is a call into OpenGL ES 2.0 that has already been made
entries.effect: the event's signalled value is set, and a fence that is not one of the port's events is named in the log and not touched
entries.source: SDK 26.2, Metal; the behaviour is the one its header documents, and was not read from a shared cache

entries.reason: a wait for a fence is a wait for the value the fence carries, on the event's own condition
entries.effect: the call waits for that value; since the work behind it has already been issued the value has been reached and the call returns, and a fence that is not one of the port's events is named in the log
entries.source: SDK 26.2, Metal; the behaviour is the one its header documents, and was not read from a shared cache
